name: Icedrive
tagline: Next-generation secure cloud storage with WebDAV sync.

instructions.step1: Log in at https://icedrive.net/login. (Note: Icedrive requires an active Pro plan for WebDAV access).
instructions.step2: Go to Settings › Access › WebDAV. Toggle 'Enable WebDAV' ON to generate your dedicated WebDAV Key.
instructions.step3: Enter your account email and paste the generated WebDAV Key (NOT your login password) below.

fields.label: WebDAV Endpoint URL
fields.helper: WebDAV gateway URL shown in your Icedrive Access settings

fields.label: Icedrive Account Email
fields.helper: The email address associated with your Icedrive account

fields.label: Dedicated WebDAV Key
fields.helper: Must be the dedicated WebDAV Key from Settings › Access (do NOT use your login password)
